I couldn't reproduce the issue on 4.7.2 and 4.7 stable.

> Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.9034) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (192000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

> I couldn't reproduce the issue on 4.7.2 and 4.7 stable.
> 
> > Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.9034) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (192000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

I am 99% sure it also happened when I removed all loading code, so basically the game did nothing other than spinning the Loading label forever, but I didn't write it down immediatelly so can't be 100% sure, now I also have a Timer node therefore I can't confirm exactly what I did the other day. However, I remember I did that test after several failures and not closing the Editor. If that were the case, then the problem is not background loading, it is something related to the editor/debug mode.
So far, it hasn't happened again. Windows bug? Editor bug? Don't know but at least it never happened with the Release build, which would be catastrophic. Now it is just annoying having to F8 and F5 again but once it runs everything works.
